parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all();const source=$('Code - Apply Podcast Automation Configuration').first().json;const record=rows.map(i=>i.json).find(j=>j&&Object.keys(j).length&&(j.id||j.fields));const f=record?.fields||record||{};const bool=value=>value===true||String(value||'').trim().toLowerCase()==='true';const rawThreshold=f.context_risk_review_threshold;const threshold=rawThreshold!==undefined&&rawThreshold!==null&&String(rawThreshold).trim()!==''?Number(rawThreshold):NaN;return [{json:{...source,allow_error_writes:f.allow_error_writes===undefined?source.allow_error_writes:bool(f.allow_error_writes),context_risk_review_threshold:Number.isFinite(threshold)?threshold:source.context_risk_review_threshold,episode_found:Boolean(record),episode_record:f,episode_state:String(f.status||'RECEIVED').toUpperCase(),transcription_job_id:f.transcription_job_id||source.transcription_job_id||'',episode_id:f.episode_id||source.episode_id||source.episode_dedupe_key,last_completed_stage:String(f.last_completed_stage||source.last_completed_stage||'INTAKE_VALIDATED')}}];

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json;let seeded={};try{seeded=$('Code - Apply Podcast Automation Configuration').first().json||seeded;}catch{}try{seeded=$('Code - Check Intake Storage Configuration').first().json||seeded;}catch{}const x={...seeded,...input};const text=String(x.error?.message||x.error_message||x.message||'Boundary operation failed').replace(/(?:bearer|token|key|secret|authorization)[^\s]*/ig,'[REDACTED]');return [{json:{workflow_name:"Episode Intake",execution_id:$execution.id,stage:"EPISODE_INTAKE",episode_id:x.episode_id||'',asset_id:x.asset_id||'',asset_version:Number(x.asset_version||0),stage_run_key:x.computed_stage_run_key||x.stage_run_key||'',attempt_number:Number(x.attempt_number||1),error_code:String(x.error?.code||x.error_code||'BOUNDARY_FAILURE'),error_message:text.slice(0,500),retryable:Boolean(x.retryable),test_mode:x.test_mode!==false,allow_external_writes:false,allow_error_writes:x.allow_error_writes===true,last_completed_stage:String(x.last_completed_stage||seeded.last_completed_stage||'')}}];

parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json;const source=$('Code - Restore Source Binary For AssemblyAI Upload').item.json;const upload_url=String(response.upload_url||'');const valid=/^https:\/\//i.test(upload_url);const request=valid?{audio_url:upload_url,speech_models:['universal-3-pro','universal-2'],language_detection:true,speaker_labels:true,punctuate:true,format_text:true}:null;return [{json:{...source,assemblyai_upload_response:response,assemblyai_upload_valid:valid,upload_url,assemblyai_submit_request:request,callback_mode:'authenticated_polling',callback_disabled_reason:'secure webhook secret injection is not configured'}}];

nodes.name: Code - Parse AssemblyAI Transcript Submission

parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json;const source=$('Code - Validate AssemblyAI Upload And Build Transcript Request').item.json;const id=String(body.id||'');const status=String(body.status||'').toLowerCase();const accepted=Boolean(id)&&['queued','processing','completed'].includes(status);return [{json:{...source,provider_response:body,transcription_job_id:id,provider_state:status,submission_accepted:accepted,last_completed_stage:accepted?'TRANSCRIPTION_SUBMITTED':source.last_completed_stage,error_code:accepted?'':'ASSEMBLYAI_SUBMIT_RESPONSE_INVALID',retryable:false}}];

nodes.name: Code - Hold Ambiguous AssemblyAI Submission

parameters.jsCode: const e=$input.first().json;const source=$('Code - Validate AssemblyAI Upload And Build Transcript Request').item.json;const status=Number(e.statusCode||e.error?.statusCode||0);const ambiguous=status===0||status>=500;return [{json:{...source,error:e,provider_state:ambiguous?'HELD_AMBIGUOUS':'FAILED',error_code:ambiguous?'ASSEMBLYAI_SUBMIT_AMBIGUOUS':'ASSEMBLYAI_SUBMIT_REJECTED',retryable:false,operator_reconciliation_required:ambiguous}}];

parameters.jsCode: const record=$input.first().json;const source=$('Code - Check Intake Storage Configuration').first().json;const fields=record.fields||record||{};const read=(...keys)=>{for(const key of keys)if(fields[key]!==undefined&&fields[key]!==null&&String(fields[key]).trim()!=='')return fields[key];return undefined;};const bool=value=>value===true||String(value||'').trim().toLowerCase()==='true';const rawThreshold=read('context_risk_review_threshold','Context Risk Review Threshold');const hasThreshold=rawThreshold!==undefined&&rawThreshold!==null&&String(rawThreshold).trim()!=='';const threshold=hasThreshold?Number(rawThreshold):NaN;return [{json:{...source,automation_config_record_id:String(record.id||''),automation_config:fields,allow_error_writes:bool(read('allow_error_writes','Allow Error Writes')),context_risk_review_threshold:Number.isFinite(threshold)?threshold:null,last_completed_stage:String(source.last_completed_stage||'INTAKE_VALIDATED')}}];
